name: message-scroller
description: A source-owned auto-anchoring chat scroll container (MessageScroller/MessageScrollerViewport/MessageScrollerContent/MessageScrollerItem/MessageScrollerButton), backed by the owned adico-primitives scroll-anchoring primitive.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over adico_primitives::message_scroller (task 10.2): native onscroll/onmounted/onresize track scroll position and auto-follow appended content while pinned to the bottom, without forcing a scroll once the user has scrolled away from it (see packages/adico-primitives/src/message_scroller.rs's own header comment for the full design, including why prepend anchoring relies on native CSS scroll-anchoring rather than hand-rolled offset math). MessageScrollerItem/MessageScrollerButton are pure composition over the primitive's two hooks -- no dedicated primitive component behind them, the same split this crate's carousel.rs already uses for CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext.
documentation.accessibility: No dedicated WAI-ARIA pattern applies to a scrollable message viewport (packages/adico-primitives/src/message_scroller.rs); MessageScrollerButton is a real Button, so it is reachable and operable like any other button.
documentation.keyboard: The viewport is natively scrollable (arrow keys/Page Up/Page Down/Home/End work once it has focus, same as any overflow:auto container); MessageScrollerButton is Tab/Enter-operable like any Button.
